current.text: Johnson is a rookie and was a top 10 pick in the 2026 NBA draft.
Johnson is hurt, as are Lively and Dharma. That leaves Gafford as the likely opening night center.
Experts see a path to a starting job, possibly at center while Lively is out. Josh is not sure about this.
The Dallas frontcourt is crowded with Lively, Gafford, Powell, P.J. Washington and Aldama. New head coach Dusty May has not shown how he will split the center minutes.
Experts expect Dallas to make another move, possibly trading Gafford.
His Yahoo ADP was 116 in late September. Expert rankings put him around 150 to 166.
Johnson is Josh's late swing pick over Washington in standard formats, and a reasonable late flyer. His upside is 30 minutes a night with about 12 points, 9 rebounds, 1.5 blocks and a steal.
Dallas has a 4-4-4 schedule in the fantasy playoffs, one of the best, but a league-high 16 back-to-backs.

durable.text: Johnson is an undersized 6'9 big. He plays more like a four than a five.
Motor is his main strength. He is a hard-working energy big who rebounds, scores mismatches in the post and has strong finishing numbers.
His defensive stats at Michigan were very strong. He had one of the best lateral quickness measurements at the combine.
His shooting is a question. He shot some threes in college and Summer League, but experts do not see him as a real stretch big. It is also unclear whether he can create his own usage.

His projected profile is a modest FG% (53.2%), blocks and low-turnover helper who gives few threes and assists. He makes sense only as a last-round flyer for a big-man build. Early in the season, check his health and whether he or Gafford starts at center while Lively is out. A Gafford trade would open minutes for him.
